claim: The CloudWatch concepts page defines an alarm as watching a single metric over a specified time period and performing one or more specified actions based on the value of the metric relative to a threshold over time, and it names a notification sent to an Amazon SNS topic or an Auto Scaling policy as the action; it is not a complete list of alarm actions.
note: d023 The concepts page names only SNS and Auto Scaling; the Alarm actions page lists more (Lambda, EC2 stop/terminate/reboot/recover, Systems Manager OpsItems and incidents): see cloudwatch-alarm-supported-action-types. Do not teach SNS and Auto Scaling as the only actions.
